per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should complete parts searches within 15 seconds on a tablet using mobile data.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for recycled parts shall take no longer than 15 seconds. The search results shall be returned in under 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should complete shop searches within 8 seconds on a tablet using mobile data.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for the preferred repair facility shall take no longer than 8 seconds. The preferred repair facility is returned within 8 seconds'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should apply performance targets for both mobile data and Wi-Fi.
The system should show a clear progress indicator and allow multitasking if searches are slow.
The system's UI should align with corporate UI standards for familiarity.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall comply with corporate User Interface Guidelines'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should allow text sizes to be adjustable for readability.
The system should have discoverable help on about 90% of screens.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The user shall easily locate instructions while using the product. User help can be found within 90% of the system.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should provide two days of hands-on training per cohort.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy to learn by Adjusters and Collision Estimators. The product shall be learned with two days onsite training'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should have strict access controls to prevent viewing other companies' claims.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'One insurance company shall not be able to view another insurance companys claim data.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should track who, what, and when for parts selection, ratings, and edits in audit logs.
The system should be protected against DoS attacks and unauthorized access on public networks.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall prevent malicious attacks including denial of service.'
'The product shall achieve a 98% uptime. The product shall not fail more than 2% of the available online time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should provide advance notice for maintenance downtime.
The system should allow recycled parts usage to be traceable with supplier details and reasons.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall interface with the Choice Parts System. This provides the feed of recycled parts data.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should work automatically with geolocation (with permission) for shop searches.
The system should show cached results with timestamps if the Choice Parts feed is down.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall interface with the Choice Parts System. This provides the feed of recycled parts data.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should provide monthly summaries (PDF/CSV) on recycled parts usage.
